subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add a producer-owned structured progress metrics contract to plugin hook events, and which runtime source owns `stepTotal`, `percent`, ETA, and terminal metrics across supported run paths?
rationale: The implementation shape is feasible, but these fields become public Plugin SDK semantics and automation should not invent progress source-of-truth rules.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover active producers with focused tests.

options.title: Keep hooks event-based
options.body: Leave plugins to derive progress from existing lifecycle and tool events, accepting text-only live cards until a stronger progress source exists.

options.title: Design a separate progress surface
options.body: Create a dedicated progress event or agent-event projection instead of attaching percentages to tool and terminal hooks.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where the runtime can produce authoritative values, document unknown fields as absent, and cover active producers with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for public hook contract ownership points to vincentkoc's hook type and registry work.
